name: Book of the Dead

text.trigger: A non-exiled player's survivor finishes a search at the Library.
text.vignette: Inside a locked case at the back of the library sits a huge hand-lettered volume with a cracked spine. It is heavy enough to be a weapon and odd enough to be a treasure, and you only have room in your pack for one idea of what it is for.

options.keep-it: Carry it home as a curiosity and let it cheer people up: morale rises by 1.
options.swing-it: Use it as a club on the nearest zombie and loot the body: remove 1 zombie from the Library and add 4 food.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #69; killZombies has no killer, so nothing rolls exposure
